Jasmin SMS Gateway setup

telnet 127.0.0.1 8990 using jcliadmin/jclipwd

#Adding SMPP connection
smppccm -a

cid RANK_6797
host 10.204.181.70
port 5019
username 6797
password Rank@#67
submit_throughput 110
ok

#Starting the connector
smppccm -1 RANK_6797

smppccm --list

#Configure simple route
mtrouter -a

type defaultroute
connector smppc(RANK_6797)
rate 0.00
ok

#Create a user
group -a
gid g_rank6797
ok

user -a

username u_rank6797
password p_rank6797
gid g_rank6797
uid u_rank6797
ok

exit

#Start api
sudo systemctl start jasmin-restapi
